A slow day around Saltmarsh Bay

Follow the water from the quiet inlet to the open headland.

This walking guide connects three public paths. Carry drinking water, check the tide before setting out and turn back whenever the weather makes the exposed coast uncomfortable.

Three places to explore on foot

  1. The inlet boardwalk

    Begin beside the small inlet where the wooden path follows still water. Benches offer space to stop and sketch the shoreline.

    Sheltered water, level path

    Start gently

    Read the inlet directions

  2. The reed-bed lookout

    Continue beneath the willows until the trail opens onto the marsh. Keep voices low and watch for movement between the reeds.

    Marsh edge, shaded trail

    Bring binoculars

    Read the lookout directions

  3. The headland loop

    The final loop climbs above the bay on rough ground. Stay on the marked path and take the sheltered return route if the wind rises.

    Open coast, uneven ground

    Allow extra daylight

    Read the headland directions

Leave shells and plants where they are, carry litter home and give wildlife plenty of space.
